name: WSU Summer Medical Academy (Weber State University)
org: Weber State University, Pre-Medical Professional Program
what_you_do: Try out health care careers in a short summer camp. You do lab activities, hear from health workers and patients, and learn how to get ready for health school.
pay_detail: $350. This covers a t-shirt, lodging, meals and lab supplies.
deadline_text: The 2026 session was July 13 to 16, 2026. The 2027 dates are not posted. The page lets you sign up for notices about future sessions.
how_to_apply: First pay online and write down your confirmation number. Then fill out the application form linked on the program page. Print all documents before check in.
notes: The 2026 page listed 35 seats. Use the email on the program page for questions.
